name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: In Dropping Reflecting Pool Case, Pirro Draws Trump’s Wrath
changes.summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney in Washington, blamed shoddy construction, contradicting President Trump’s pet theory. Mr. Trump said he disagreed “100%” with her.

changes.title: Trump says deal to end Iran war may be imminent, agrees to "cancel the attack"
changes.summary: On Saturday, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke with Mr. Trump and cautioned him against conducting a fresh round of strikes on Iran, CBS News learned.

changes.title: Fox News Campus Radicals Newsletter: Parents left in the dark, Trump starving socialist breeding grounds
changes.summary: FAMILY UNDER SIEGE: Controversial teacher training targets parental authority as oppression, education expert warns LIZ PEEK : Trump is starving the machine that creates America's socialist revolutionaries HEATED EXCHANGE: Piers Morgan eviscerates Ivy League student who refused to work 'for a Jew' as 'brazenly' antisem.

changes.title: Trump climbs down on Iran strikes after Saudi alarm and threats from Tehran
changes.summary: President claims delay is ‘subject to being able to rapidly make a deal’ as intervention by Saudi crown prince is revealed and Iran warns neighbours Donald Trump said on Saturday night that the US would hold off on any new strikes on Iran provided a deal to end the months-long conflict is quickly reached – marking the.

changes.title: Trump Says He Is Canceling Strikes on Iran, Pending a Rapid Deal
changes.summary: President Trump said he agreed to requests from Iran and other Middle Eastern countries to cancel planned attacks, citing what he said was progress in reaching the “perimeters of a deal” with Tehran.

changes.title: Trump’s Fixation on Arctic Ships Led to Billions in No-Bid Contracts
changes.summary: The president decided to buy 11 polar icebreakers after a game of golf with Finland’s president. Experts say it’s far from clear the United States needs so many.

changes.title: Trump Administration Is Undoing Plans to Boost Workplace Heat Protections
changes.summary: The Biden administration took steps to shield workers from extreme temperatures. The Trump administration is taking a gentler approach with employers.

changes.title: Charges Dropped Against Ex-Olympian David Hearn Accused of Damaging Reflecting Pool
changes.summary: A former Olympian will not face trial after federal prosecutors acknowledged that the Trump administration’s claims of vandalism were false.

changes.title: How Ukraine Is Making Inroads With MAGA and a Trump Ally, Laura Loomer
changes.summary: Ukraine and its supporters have invested years in trying to undo the skepticism of the country’s war effort harbored by President Trump’s MAGA movement and the president himself.

changes.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
changes.summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.
